Ask the Yelp community!Recommended ReviewsChoose a star rating on a scale of 1 to 51 star ratingNot good2 star ratingCould’ve been better3 star ratingOK4 star ratingGood5 star ratingGreatSelect your ratingStart your review of Trader Joe'sSearch reviewsSearch reviewsI wish they would open a Trader Joe's in my town. That being said the folks in the ft Wayne store are awesome. They keep the place clean and organized all the time even when they are super busy. The employees are friendly and knowledgeable. No matter what I am looking for they direct me to the location where it is and when the shelves are empty they go in the back looking for my request. The manager is fantastic especially "the long haired guy"!!!The variety of things like imported items are amazing. Trader Joe's is a godsend for those of us that love variety and different styles and flavors.Love Trader Joe's although I don't shop there as often as I would like since the location is quite a distance. Staff is always pleasant and knowledgeable. Prices and selection are great. When I do treat myself to a shopping trip there I always find something new and fun to try.The staff is consistently kind and helpful, and I've noticed shoppers helping one another out as well. We're delighted to have a Trader Joe's in town.Trader Joe's remains one of the coolest grocery stores to date. They keep great looking fresh produce, economical frozen items and the best salsa outside of a restaurant. I love their flowers and plants. They all appear to well tended and vibrant. They've got an amazing staff, except for one person in the dairy section. They all want you to have an easy experience, they want you to get great items at great prices and that is their super power.Great selection of food! The staff was super nice and helpful. The location was so clean and well spaced out. A nice spot to grab a some healthy meals and treats for an out-of-towner for a couple of days.This is a happy place. Fresh fruits, vegetables, salad, juices, smoothie, bread, frozen food, skin care, flowers and so much moreI stopped by Trader Joe's to see if there was anything interesting, and as always, there was! The yogurt I bought was delicious! I got a coconut yogurt as well as a guava passion fruit one. Definitely recommend! The service was also great, the kids got a lollypop at the checkout and some stickers! The store looked clean and tidy, super easy to find items.What can I say it's like all the wonderful amazing Trader Joe's I've ever been to across the country. This is my all time favorite place to go for unique and different groceries and gifts and plants and everything. Amazing employees that are always smiling and friendly. Great products that taste amazing. Clean clean store from the parking lot to the bathroom. Located at Jefferson pointe is the perfect location for this perfect store. A must stop place for anything unique. Including booze!! Very cool products and groceries.If Trader Joe's is a cult ... sign me up! I absolutely love everything about this store. The employees are amazing. The prices are amazing. The selections are unmatched. Just perfect vibes. I had my 3 small children in the store with me and were trying to get out quickly so an associate stopped what she was doing, grabbed a sticky pad and wrote down everything I needed. She then proceeded to run around the store, checked computers to see what was in stock and grabbing what I needed. Even checked the back stock for items that weren't on the shelf. She then rang me up and insisted on walking me to my car to put my groceries in my trunk. We then had like a 5 minute conversation, she even asked my name. Like, WHAT? That's unheard of. Will definitely frequent TJ's. I really love their dark chocolate raisins (so addictive!), Turkey burgers, dumplings, chicken cheddar sausage, plantain chips, nectarines, peaches, mango jicama slaw, the list goes on and on.Trader Joe's is a long awaited addition to the ft Wayne grocery store scene. I've been multiple times now and feel worthy of a review. First, the store is not huge, and so you don't feel overwhelmed. The produce section is small, but really the reason you're here isn't for produce. The pre made dinners, frozen foods, etc. are really what shine. The staff has been friendly, and it's quick to checkout. I like it, and will continue to frequent it.1 other review that is not currently recommendedPeople Also ViewedGrocery, Butcher, Cheese ShopsInexpensiveGrocery, Meat ShopsInternational Grocery, Meat Shops, Seafood Markets
